scenes.headline: How the harness alone adds points
scenes.sub: Apodex 1.1 and FrontierAgent: one checkpoint, two harnesses, six benchmarks.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Cocoa! One team published the same model's scores under two different harnesses. That shows what the scaffolding alone is worth. Here's how it works.

scenes.text: A coordinator that keeps only a task board and structured reports, never the sub-agents' raw observations, can add points without new weights.
scenes.say: The idea: a coordinator that holds only a task board and structured reports, never the raw observations, can add points with the same weights.

steps.say: A request goes to a coordinator. Its state is a task board: pending, active, completed, blocked or cancelled.
It decomposes the job and dispatches bounded assignments to expert sub-agents, working in parallel.
Each returns a structured report to a shared pool. The coordinator reads reports, never the pages and commands behind them.
Before delivery, Statement Review checks key claims against their sources, data and computations, and corrects what doesn't hold.

left.title: One ReAct loop
items: Every page, command and error stays in context
Its back half reasons over finished work
Past the window, something must be dropped
left.say: A single ReAct agent keeps every page, command and error in one context. Past the window, something must be dropped.

right.title: Agent Team
items: The work is spread across sub-agents
right.say: Fanning out doesn't shrink the work, it spreads who holds it. Though the gain might come from the review pass instead.

scenes.title: Points added: weights vs harness
scenes.note: token cost and wall clock for Agent Team are not reported
scenes.say: On BioMysteryBench the harness added eleven point eight points, against five point nine from new weights. On another benchmark, they're near parity. Token cost isn't reported.

scenes.text: The scaffold is a first-class contributor to capability, and holding the weights fixed is the way to measure it.

recap: A coordinator with a task board, not a transcript
Parallel sub-agents, structured reports, a review pass
Same checkpoint, two harnesses: about 40% of the gain
scenes.say: To recap: a coordinator with a task board, sub-agents that report, a review pass, and a harness worth about forty percent of the gain.
